_comment: D13-F2: serializer key order, nested shapes, DRF error bodies. Key order = Meta.fields order = JSON key order. All datetimes render ISO8601 UTC (+00:00, microseconds when present) per USE_TZ+TIME_ZONE=UTC and no DATETIME_FORMAT override.

RUNNER_NAME_CHARSET.message: runner_name must start with a letter, digit, or underscore and contain only letters, digits, underscore, dot, or dash
RUNNER_NAME_CHARSET.semantics: identical character class to views/enrollment.py _RUNNER_NAME_RE (charset uses literal '-' at class end; view uses '\-'; both match the same set — verified by probe). Used ONLY by RunnerEnrollRequestSerializer.name; the create/machine-command endpoints use _RUNNER_NAME_RE with a DIFFERENT message (see flows invalid_runner_name).

dev_machine_mini.note: id = uuid string; host_label/label plain strings. All read-only.

annotated_fields.control_online: BooleanField(read_only, default=False) -> renders false when queryset did not annotate (verified empirically)
annotated_fields.last_heartbeat_at: DateTimeField(read_only, NO default) -> key OMITTED when attribute missing (un-annotated instance); renders ISO8601 UTC when annotated (possibly null when Max() over zero rows -> None renders null)
annotated_fields.online_runner_count: IntegerField(read_only, NO default) -> key OMITTED when attribute missing
annotated_fields.runner_count: IntegerField(read_only, NO default) -> key OMITTED when attribute missing

dev_machine_serializer.note: ModelSerializer over DevMachine; visibility renders the INTEGER (0); revoked_at renders null when unset; all fields read-only.

enroll_validation_400.body_shape: {"field": ["message", ...]} — standard DRF serializer error dict, HTTP 400 via is_valid(raise_exception=True)

host_label: This field may not be blank.

enrollment_token: Ensure this field has at least 16 characters.
Ensure this field has no more than 128 characters.

os: Ensure this field has no more than 32 characters.

cases.input: {name: '.hidden'} — RegexValidator message; note allow_blank=True + default='' so MISSING name is fine and '' passes (blank skips validators)

enroll_validation_400.method_note: Message strings verified by executing equivalent DRF fields against the installed DRF (probe /tmp/d13_drf.py); field specs read from serializers.py:223-238. Blank-name '' passes because allow_blank short-circuits validators in DRF.
enroll_validation_400.validated_data_defaults: missing name/os/arch/version -> '' (default); missing dev_machine_id -> key ABSENT from validated_data (required=False, no default)

method: Field lists + validators transcribed from the cited lines; null-vs-omitted semantics and DRF message strings verified by executing equivalent DRF constructs against the installed DRF/Django (probes /tmp/d13_nested.py, /tmp/d13_drf.py — real DRF mechanics, field specs from real source). No DB touched.

pod_mini.note: project = FK uuid string; project_identifier = project.identifier slug via source traversal. All read-only.

fields.created_by: FK uuid string, or null (SET_NULL allowed)
fields.name: string
fields.project: FK uuid string (read-only on the wire)

runner_count_mismatch.actual_behavior: get_runner_count returns pod.runners.count() — UNFILTERED, INCLUDES revoked runners. Verified: method body is exactly `return pod.runners.count()` (AST probe, no status filter).
runner_count_mismatch.comment_claim: pods.py:226-228 comment says the delete guard (which EXCLUDES revoked) 'matches PodSerializer.get_runner_count' — WRONG. The guard and the serializer differ: guard excludes revoked, serializer counts them.
runner_count_mismatch.port: port actual behaviour (count includes revoked); the comment is a docs bug, listed as a ported quirk

pod_serializer.writable: name + description only (all other fields in read_only_fields); create/rename validation is custom in pods.py, NOT via this serializer

fields.dev_machine_id: UUIDField(required=False) — NO default, so absent from validated_data when missing
fields.host_label: CharField(max_length=255) — required; '' REJECTED with 'This field may not be blank.' (allow_blank defaults False — verified on pinned DRF 3.15.2); view truncates [:255] again
fields.name: CharField(max_length=128, required=False, allow_blank=True, default='', validators=[RUNNER_NAME_CHARSET])

runner_enroll_request.note: Plain Serializer (not ModelSerializer). Unknown extra keys are IGNORED (not an error). validated_data consumed by RunnerEnrollEndpoint.post.

nested.dev_machine: FK uuid string, or null when unset
nested.dev_machine_detail: DevMachineMini shape, or NULL when dev_machine FK unset (verified empirically: None renders null, key present)
nested.live_state: RunnerLiveState shape (key order: observed_run_id, last_event_at, last_event_kind, last_event_summary, agent_pid, agent_subprocess_alive, approvals_pending, input_tokens, output_tokens, total_tokens, usage, llm_model, turn_count, updated_at — serializers.py:86-99), or NULL when the reverse one-to-one row is missing (verified empirically: ObjectDoesNotExist -> None, key present)
nested.pod_detail: PodMini shape (always present; pod FK non-null)

runner_serializer.note: ModelSerializer over Runner; ONLY name and pod are writable (everything else in read_only_fields); PATCH handler does custom assignment, not serializer.save. status/provisioning render the string values; visibility the int; capabilities/dev_metadata raw JSON; datetimes ISO8601 UTC / null.
